# 7489 - 64-bit read/write memory

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7489.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7489.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 19 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7489 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7489.png) | ![7489 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-7489.png) | ![7489 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-7489.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | S1 = NOT (ME' AND WE AND M[D,C,B,A].bit1) | Sense output 1: while reading (ME low, WE high) it is the complement of bit 1 of the addressed word; while writing (ME low, WE low) and while ME is high it is at logical 1 (open-collector off). |
| 7 | S2 = NOT (ME' AND WE AND M[D,C,B,A].bit2) | Sense output 2: while reading (ME low, WE high) it is the complement of bit 2 of the addressed word; while writing (ME low, WE low) and while ME is high it is at logical 1 (open-collector off). |
| 9 | S3 = NOT (ME' AND WE AND M[D,C,B,A].bit3) | Sense output 3: while reading (ME low, WE high) it is the complement of bit 3 of the addressed word; while writing (ME low, WE low) and while ME is high it is at logical 1 (open-collector off). |
| 11 | S4 = NOT (ME' AND WE AND M[D,C,B,A].bit4) | Sense output 4: while reading (ME low, WE high) it is the complement of bit 4 of the addressed word; while writing (ME low, WE low) and while ME is high it is at logical 1 (open-collector off). |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 64

Changes on: while ME and WE are both low (write)

- 16 words of 4 bits, selected by the four select inputs A, B, C, D (fully decoded)
- ME low, WE low: write D1-D4 into the addressed word; outputs at logical 1
- ME low, WE high: read; outputs show the complement of the addressed word
- ME high: hold (no write); outputs at logical 1
- Read-out is nondestructive

| notes | Open-collector outputs (wire-OR). IOL 12 mA, VOL max 0.4 V (DM74). Off-state output current IOH max 20 uA at VOH 5.5 V (DM74). Highest output voltage given: VOH 5.5 V. National lists these under electrical characteristics; the sheet has no separate recommended-operating-conditions table. |

## Not known

- Which select input is the least significant address bit: the connection diagram names them A, B, C, D and the logic diagram A0-A3, but the sheet does not tie the two sets of names together.
- Reference edge of the setup and hold times with respect to Write Enable: not stated.
- Power-up content of the memory: not stated.
- IOH as a source current does not apply (open collector); outputHighMaxCurrentMa is null.

## Notes

ND symbol title says 64-bit read/write memory; this file uses the National DM7489 sheet, which describes the same 16 x 4 part with open-collector inverted outputs. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.

## Sources

- [National Semiconductor TTL Data Book 1976, DM54/DM7489, L89A 64-Bit Read/Write Memories](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/national/_dataBooks/1976_National_TTL_Databook.pdf) - 2-28, 2-29 (PDF pages 175-176); DM7489 (National; TI's 1976 TTL book does not carry the 7489)
